Neuronal/Glial lineage development

```{r}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(stringi)
library(patchwork)

```



# 1. Trajectory analysis
Skipped batch correction for age, because age is a biological variable of interest (developmental time course)
Skipped batch correction for region, because each region will be analysed separately
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")
```

## (1) neuronal lineage
```{r}
set.seed(100)
addArchRThreads(8)

# prepare UMAP ~ 30s
ArchR_lineage_neuro <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region)){
  print(x)
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]] <- ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region == x & ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0 %in% 
                                              c("Neuron", "Neuroblast", "Neuronal IPC", "Radial glia"),]
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]@projectMetadata@listData[["outputDirectory"]] <- "./ArchR_lineage/Neuronal"
  
  # add UMAP
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]] <- addUMAP(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], reducedDims = "Harmony_age",name = "UMAP_neuro", 
                                      nNeighbors = 30, minDist = 0.5, metric = "cosine", force = TRUE)
  
  # save UMAP plots
  plotPDF(plotEmbedding(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Age", 
                        embedding = "UMAP_neuro",  labelMeans=FALSE,
                        pal = c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452", CS21="#f2de5c")),
          name = paste0("neuro_UMAP_",x,"_Age.pdf"), 
          ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], addDOC = FALSE, width = 6, height = 6)
  plotPDF(plotEmbedding(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], colorBy = "cellColData", name = "ctAnnot_2.0", 
                        embedding = "UMAP_neuro",  labelMeans=FALSE,
                        pal = c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff", "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 
                                'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")), 
          name = paste0("neuro_UMAP_",x,"_ct.pdf"), 
          ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], addDOC = FALSE, width = 6, height = 6)
  rm(x)
}
```

```{r}
# compute trajectory, split early/late stages ~ 3s
p <- list()
i <- 1
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)){
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage <- stri_replace_all_regex(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Age, vectorise_all = FALSE,
                                                           pattern = c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"),
                                                           replacement = paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Early","Late","Late","Late")))
  for (y in unique(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage)){
    # keep only cells in the given stage
    ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Traj_label <- NA
    ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Traj_label[ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage==y] <-
      ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$ctAnnot_2.0[ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage==y]

    # add a trajectory for the given stage on the shared UMAP
    ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]] <- addTrajectory(ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y,
                                              groupBy = "Traj_label", reducedDims = "Harmony_age",
                                 trajectory = c("Radial glia","Neuronal IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"), embedding = "UMAP_neuro",
                                 preFilterQuantile = 0.98, postFilterQuantile = 0.98, force = TRUE, spar = 1.1)
    p[[i]] <- plotTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], embedding = "UMAP_neuro", trajectory = y, colorBy = "cellColData", name = y,
                             plotAs = "points", continuousSet = "solarExtra")
    i <- i+1
  }
}
rm(i, x, y)

# saving PDF ~ 6s
pdf("./ArchR_lineage/Neuronal/Plots/neuro_trajectory_all.pdf", width = 3, height = 3.6)
p[[1]][[1]]
p[[2]][[1]]
p[[3]][[1]]
p[[4]][[1]]
p[[5]][[1]]
p[[6]][[1]]
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# pseudo-time heatmap for gene score ~ 1.5 min
colours <- c("Neuron"="#3ee2ff", "Neuroblast"="#00cfff", "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", "Radial glia"="#836dff")
p1 <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)){
  for (y in paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Late"))){
    print(y)
    trajGSM <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", log2Norm = FALSE, 
                             trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")

                                    colorColumns = TRUE, columnPal = colours[unique(trajGSM@colData@listData[["label"]])])
  }
}
rm(x, y, trajGSM)
```

```{r}
pdf("./ArchR_lineage/Neuronal/Plots/neuro_genescore_heatmap1.pdf", width = 7.2, height = 5.6)
p1
```

# 2. TF activity
## (1) ct-region-specific TF
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script7/ArchR_lineage_neuro.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script7/ArchR_lineage_glial.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script3/heatmap_summary_ctRegion.rda")

# get ct-region-specific TFs from Script3
TF_glial <- c("NFIX","NFIA","NFIB")
TF_neuro <- unique(heatmap_summary_ctRegion$gene)
TF_neuro <- TF_neuro[TF_neuro %ni% TF_glial]
TF_neuro <-as.vector(TF_neuro)
```


## (2) glial lineage (Late only)
```{r}
# select TFs that have correlated gene score and motif chromVAR z score, and also in the ct-region-spc list from script 3 ~ 1.5 min
heatmap <- list()
for (x in c("CerebellumPons","Medulla")){
  for (y in paste0(x, "_Late")){
    print(y)
    
    # get gene score and chromVAR trend using pseudotime bins
    trajMotif  <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_glial[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", 
                                log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    trajGeneScore <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_glial[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                                   log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    
    # correlation for all TFs
    cor <- correlateTrajectories(trajGeneScore, trajMotif)
    cor <- cor[["allMappings"]][! grepl("deviations",cor[["allMappings"]]$name2),]
    cor$group <- y
    cor <- as.data.frame(cor)
    
    # significant correlations
    ## significance cutoff: FDR < 0.01, correlation >=0.5
    ## biological cutoff: top 20% variable features - VarAssay1 >= 0.8 , VarAssay2 >=0.8
    trajCor_sig <- cor[cor$FDR <= 0.01 & cor$Correlation >=0.5 & cor$VarAssay1 >= 0.8 & cor$VarAssay2 >= 0.8,]
    trajCor_fil <- trajCor_sig[trajCor_sig$matchname1 %in% c(TF_glial, TF_neuro),]
    trajGeneScore <- trajGeneScore[trajCor_fil$name1, ]
    trajMotif <- trajMotif[trajCor_fil$name2, ]
    
    # combined
    trajCombined <- trajGeneScore
    assay(trajCombined, withDimnames=FALSE) <- t(apply(assay(trajGeneScore), 1, scale)) + t(apply(assay(trajMotif), 1, scale))
    combinedMat <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajCombined, returnMat = TRUE, varCutOff = 0)
    rowOrder <- match(rownames(combinedMat), rownames(trajGeneScore))
    
    # fix gene names
    trajGeneScore@NAMES <- sub(".*:","",trajGeneScore@NAMES)
    trajMotif@NAMES <- NULL
    
    # plotting
    heatmap[[y]] <- list()
    heatmap[[y]][[1]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajGeneScore,  pal = c("#704D9E", "#BC5AA9", "#ED7C97", "#f79452", "#f2de5c"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, labelRows = TRUE, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = c("Radial glia"="#836dff","Glioblast"="#c47df0"))
    heatmap[[y]][[2]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMotif,  pal = paletteContinuous(set = "whitePurple"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = c("Radial glia"="#836dff","Glioblast"="#c47df0"))
    heatmap[[y]][[2]]@ht_list[["MotifMatrix"]]@top_annotation@anno_list[["label"]]@label <- ""
  }
  rm(x, y, cor, trajCor_sig, trajCor_fil, trajGeneScore, trajMotif, trajCombined, combinedMat, rowOrder)
}
```

```{r}
p <- heatmap[["CerebellumPons_Late"]][[2]] + heatmap[["CerebellumPons_Late"]][[1]]
draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, gap = unit(-2, "mm"))
```

```{r}
p <- heatmap[["Medulla_Late"]][[2]] + heatmap[["Medulla_Late"]][[1]]
draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, gap = unit(-2, "mm"))
```


## (3) neuronal lineage
```{r}
# select TFs that have correlated gene score and motif chromVAR z score, and also in the ct-region-spc list from script 3 ~ 4 min
heatmap <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)){
  for (y in paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Late"))){
    print(y)
    
    # get gene score and chromVAR trend using pseudotime bins
    trajMotif  <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", 
                                log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    trajGeneScore <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                                   log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    
    # correlation for all TFs
    cor <- correlateTrajectories(trajGeneScore, trajMotif)
    cor <- cor[["allMappings"]][! grepl("deviations",cor[["allMappings"]]$name2),]
    cor$group <- y
    cor <- as.data.frame(cor)
    
    # significant correlations
    ## significance cutoff: FDR < 0.01, correlation >=0.4
    ## biological cutoff: top 20% variable features - VarAssay1 >= 0.8 , VarAssay2 >=0.8
    trajCor_sig <- cor[cor$FDR <= 0.01 & cor$Correlation >=0.5 & cor$VarAssay1 >= 0.8 & cor$VarAssay2 >= 0.8,]
    trajCor_fil <- trajCor_sig[trajCor_sig$matchname1 %in% TF_neuro,]
    trajGeneScore <- trajGeneScore[trajCor_fil$name1, ]
    trajMotif <- trajMotif[trajCor_fil$name2, ]
    
    # combined
    trajCombined <- trajGeneScore
    assay(trajCombined, withDimnames=FALSE) <- t(apply(assay(trajGeneScore), 1, scale)) + t(apply(assay(trajMotif), 1, scale))
    combinedMat <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajCombined, returnMat = TRUE, varCutOff = 0)
    rowOrder <- match(rownames(combinedMat), rownames(trajGeneScore))
    
    # fix gene names
    trajGeneScore@NAMES <- sub(".*:","",trajGeneScore@NAMES)
    trajMotif@NAMES <- NULL
    
    # plotting
    heatmap[[y]] <- list()
    heatmap[[y]][[1]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajGeneScore,  pal = c("#704D9E", "#BC5AA9", "#ED7C97", "#f79452", "#f2de5c"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, labelRows = TRUE, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = colours[unique(trajGeneScore@colData@listData[["label"]])])
    heatmap[[y]][[2]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMotif,  pal = paletteContinuous(set = "whitePurple"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = colours[unique(trajMotif@colData@listData[["label"]])])
    heatmap[[y]][[2]]@ht_list[["MotifMatrix"]]@top_annotation@anno_list[["label"]]@label <- ""
  }
  rm(x, y, cor, trajCor_sig, trajCor_fil, trajGeneScore, trajMotif, trajCombined, combinedMat, rowOrder)
}
```

# 3. Disease risk (Neuronal only)
## (1) adding TRS
```{r}
# SCAVENGE TRS result from section 3
load("./data_rda/Script4/SCAVENGE_ctpeaks_5ct.rda")
rm(mutual_knn, mutual_knn_ct)

# get TRS for diseases of interest
disease <- c("PD","BP","ASD","ADHD")
mono_mat_ct <- mono_mat_ct[disease]
for (x in disease){
  mono_mat_ct[[x]] <- mono_mat_ct[[x]][,c("names","TRS")]
  names(mono_mat_ct[[x]])[2] <- x
  rm(x)
}
TRS_matrix <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "names", all = TRUE), mono_mat_ct)
row.names(TRS_matrix) <- TRS_matrix$names
TRS_matrix <- TRS_matrix[, -1]
TRS_matrix <- t(as.matrix(TRS_matrix))
rm(mono_mat_ct)

# replace NA with 0
TRS_matrix[is.na(TRS_matrix)] <- 0
anyNA(TRS_matrix) == FALSE # no NAs

# preprare ArchR
ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS <- ArchR_lineage_neuro[c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons")]
```

```{r}
## adding the raw TRS score without normalisation!

# 1. Unlock the binding in ArchR namespace
unlockBinding(".normalizeCols", asNamespace("ArchR"))

# 2. Customise: simply return the input matrix unchanged
.noNormalizeCols <- function(x, ...) {
  return(x)
}

# 3. Overwrite the function
assign(".normalizeCols", .noNormalizeCols, envir = asNamespace("ArchR"))

# Step 4: Lock it back for safety (optional)
lockBinding(".normalizeCols", asNamespace("ArchR"))
```

### add to forebrain
```{r}
cells <- ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain$cellNames[ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain$cellNames %in% colnames(TRS_matrix)]
ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain <- ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain[ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain$cellNames %in% cells,]
matrix <- TRS_matrix[,cells]
colnames(matrix) == ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain$cellNames
se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(data = matrix),
                                                 rowData = DataFrame(feature = rownames(matrix)),
                                                 colData = DataFrame(cellNames = colnames(matrix)))

# prepare summarizedExperiment object
seRNA <- import10xFeatureMatrix(input = c("./data_input/data_EHB_multiome/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"), names = c("SINAG3"))
seTRS <- seRNA
seTRS@colData <- se@colData
seTRS@assays <- se@assays
seTRS@NAMES <- se@NAMES
seTRS@elementMetadata <- se@elementMetadata
seTRS@rowRanges <- seTRS@rowRanges[1:4]
rownames(seTRS) <- se@NAMES

# adding TRS as gene expression matrix -> this is stored in the arrow files!!! MUST BACK UP!!!
ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain <- addGeneExpressionMatrix(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain, seTRS, force = TRUE)
getAvailableMatrices(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain)
getFeatures(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS$Forebrain, useMatrix = "GeneExpressionMatrix")
```

```{r}

ArchR_TRS_matrix@assays@data$GeneExpressionMatrix[,colnames(matrix)[1:5]]
matrix[,1:5]
```

## (2) pseudotime disease risk
### find regions/stages of interest
```{r}
p <- list()
for (x in c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons")){
  for (y in c("Early", "Late")){
    for (z in disease){
      trajectory <- paste0(x, "_", y)
      name <- paste0(x, "_", y, "_", z)
      p[[name]] <- plotTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]], embedding = "UMAP_neuro", trajectory = trajectory, 
                                  colorBy = "GeneExpressionMatrix", name = z, plotAs = "points")
      gc()
    }
  }
  rm(x, y, z, name, trajectory)
}
p1 <- unlist(p, recursive = FALSE)

for (x in disease){
  png(paste0("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script7/pseudotime_TRS_neuro_",x,".png"), width = 3500, height = 1700, res = 200)
  print(wrap_plots(p1[grep(x,names(p1))], ncol=4, byrow=FALSE, heights=c(3,1)))
  dev.off()
  rm(x)
}
```

### main fig - average TRS
```{r}
# get TRS-pseudotime smoothed matrix ~ 10s
trajTRS_smoothed <- list()
for (x in c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons")){
  for (y in c("Early", "Late")){
    i <- paste0(x,"_",y)
    
    # get average TRS
    bins <- 50 # dividing pseudotime into 100 bins
    trajTRS <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneExpressionMatrix",
                             log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0", scaleTo = NULL, 
                             groupEvery = 100/bins, smoothWindow = 10)
    trajTRS_smoothed[[i]] <- as.data.frame(trajTRS@assays@data$smoothMat)
    
    # calculate nCell per bin
    nCellperBin <- as.vector(table(cut(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]]@cellColData[[i]], breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 100/bins), 
                             include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)))
    trajTRS_smoothed[[i]] <- trajTRS_smoothed[[i]]/nCellperBin
    
    # formatting
    trajTRS_smoothed[[i]]$condition <- getFeatures(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]], useMatrix = "GeneExpressionMatrix")
    trajTRS_smoothed[[i]]$group <- i
    trajTRS_smoothed[[i]] <- pivot_longer(trajTRS_smoothed[[i]], 1:bins, names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "TRS")
    
  }
}
rm(i,x,y,trajTRS)

# formatting
trajTRS_smoothed_all <- do.call(rbind, trajTRS_smoothed)
trajTRS_smoothed_all$pseudotime <- as.numeric(sub(".*_","",trajTRS_smoothed_all$timepoint))
row.names(trajTRS_smoothed_all) <- NULL
trajTRS_smoothed_all$group <- stri_replace_all_regex(trajTRS_smoothed_all$group, pattern = c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons"), 
                                                     replacement = c("FB","CP"), vectorize_all = FALSE)

# plotting
ggplot(trajTRS_smoothed_all, aes(x = pseudotime, y = TRS, group = group, colour = group)) +
  geom_line() + facet_wrap(~condition, ncol=1) + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("CP_Early"="#53CC67", "CP_Late"="#018017", "FB_Early"="#FDE333", "FB_Late"="#c2a802")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


### main fig - permutation per bin
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script4/permutation_result.rda")
rm(mono_mat_permu_all)
disease <- c("PD","BP","ASD","ADHD")
```

```{r}
# get proportions in each bin
sig_summary <- data.frame()
for (z in disease){
  sigCells <- mono_mat_permu_ct[[z]]$names[mono_mat_permu_ct[[z]]$true_cell_top_idx == TRUE]
  
  for (x in c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons")){
    for (y in c("Early","Late")){
      for (bin in seq(2, 100, by = 2)){
        i <- paste0(x,"_",y)  
        cell_in_bin <- ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]]@cellColData@rownames[ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]]@cellColData@listData[[i]] <= bin &
                            ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]]@cellColData@listData[[i]] > bin - 2]
        cell_in_bin <- as.vector(na.omit(cell_in_bin))
        a <- sum(cell_in_bin %in% sigCells)
        b <- length(cell_in_bin)
        sig_summary <- rbind(sig_summary, c(z,x,y,i,bin,a,b,a/b))
      }
    }
  }
  rm(x,y,z,i,sigCells,cell_in_bin,bin,a,b)
}
names(sig_summary) <- c("disease","region","stage","group","pseudotime","sigCells","allCells","prop")
sig_summary$prop <- as.numeric(sig_summary$prop)
sig_summary$sigCells <- as.numeric(sig_summary$sigCells)
sig_summary$allCells <- as.numeric(sig_summary$allCells)
sig_summary$pseudotime <- as.numeric(sig_summary$pseudotime)
sig_summary$group <- stri_replace_all_regex(sig_summary$group, pattern = c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons"), 
                                            replacement = c("FB","CP"), vectorize_all = FALSE)

# compute odds ratio for each bin
sig_summary$odds_ratio <- (sig_summary$sigCells / (sig_summary$allCells - sig_summary$sigCells)) / 
  ((sum(sig_summary$sigCells) - sig_summary$sigCells) / (sum(sig_summary$allCells) - sum(sig_summary$sigCells) - (sig_summary$allCells - sig_summary$sigCells)))

# perform two-sided hypergeometric test
sig_summary$p_value <- phyper(sig_summary$sigCells - 1, sum(sig_summary$sigCells), 
                              sum(sig_summary$allCells) - sum(sig_summary$sigCells), sig_summary$allCells, lower.tail = FALSE)
sig_summary$FDR <- p.adjust(sig_summary$p_value, method = "BH")

# significant bins: FDR <= 0.05
sig_summary$text <- ""
sig_summary$text[sig_summary$FDR < 0.05] <- "significant"
```

```{r}
# plotting
ggplot(sig_summary, aes(x = pseudotime, y = odds_ratio, group = group, colour = group)) +
  geom_line() + facet_wrap(~disease, ncol=1) + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("CP_Early"="#53CC67", "CP_Late"="#018017", "FB_Early"="#FDE333", "FB_Late"="#c2a802")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


## (3) TRS ~ chromVAR
### find genes of interest
```{r}
# select TFs that have correlated TRS and motif chromVAR z score ~ 1 min
correlation_table <- list()
heatmap <- list()
for (x in c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons")){
  for (y in paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Late"))){
    print(y)
    
    # get TRS and chromVAR trend using pseudotime bins
    trajMotif  <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", 
                                log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    trajTRS <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro_TRS[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneExpressionMatrix", 
                                   log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0", scaleTo = NULL)
    names(trajTRS) <- sub(".*:","",names(trajTRS))
    
    # correlation for all TFs
    correlation_table[[y]] <- data.frame()
    for (a in 1:nrow(trajTRS)){
      for (b in (nrow(trajMotif)/2+1):nrow(trajMotif)){
        out <- cor.test(trajTRS@assays@data$mat[a,], trajMotif@assays@data$smoothMat[b,], use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
        out <- data.frame(p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate, 
                          disease = names(trajTRS)[a], motif = names(trajMotif)[b])
        correlation_table[[y]] <- rbind(correlation_table[[y]], out)
      }
      rm(a, b)
    }
    correlation_table[[y]]$FDR <- p.adjust(correlation_table[[y]]$p_value, method = "fdr")
    
    heatmap[[y]] <- list()
    for (z in disease){
      # significant correlations: FDR <= 0.01, correlation >=0.6
      cor <- correlation_table[[y]][correlation_table[[y]]$disease==z,]
      sig <- cor$motif[cor$FDR <= 0.01 & cor$coefficient >= 0.6]

      # plotting
      if (length(sig) > 1){
        heatmap[[y]][[z]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMotif[sig,],  varCutOff = 0, pal = paletteContinuous(set = "solarExtra"))  
      }
    }
    rm(z)
  }
  rm(x, y, cor, trajMotif, trajTRS)
}
save(correlation_table, heatmap, file = "./data_rda/Script7/trajCor_TRS.rda")
```

```{r}
# get significant correlations (FDR <= 0.01, correlation >= 0.6)
correlation_sig <- list()

  cor <- cor[cor$FDR <= 0.01 & cor$coefficient >= 0.6,]
```
